__nameManagerComments.partFill: Fill span by ordered parts; optional remainder rules.
__nameManagerComments.permutate: Apply lambda to all ordered A/B pairs.
__nameManagerComments.jsonJoin: Merge JSON. MODE 0 merge, 1 replace, 2 add.
__nameManagerComments.isInSet: Test value(s) against interval set text.
__nameManagerComments.arrayRepAdd: Replace or append key in 2-col array.
__nameManagerComments.jsonQuote: Quote text for JSON; keep numbers/objects raw.
__nameManagerComments.listToJson: Convert list/array to JSON array text.
__nameManagerComments.dropBySet: Keep/drop repeating columns by set rule.
__nameManagerComments.EdgeDetect: Compare each row to prev/next via detector.
__nameManagerComments.between: Interval test from text like [a,b) or a-b.
__nameManagerComments.safeFilter: Safe FILTER; blank-shaped result if none match.
__nameManagerComments.jsonGet: Read JSON value by slash path; missing -> #N/A.
__nameManagerComments.nestedJsonBuild: Build nested JSON from path and value.
__nameManagerComments.jsonSet: Set JSON key/path; builds missing branches.
__nameManagerComments.jsonGetKeysAtLevel: Split top-level JSON object into key/value rows.
__nameManagerComments.safeDrop: Safe DROP; blank-shaped result on over-drop.
__nameManagerComments.inches: Convert yard/ft/in text to inches; needs units.
__nameManagerComments.listFromJson: Split flat JSON array text to vertical list.
__nameManagerComments.jsonObject: Build JSON object from key/value rows.
